tool_input.command:
sed -n '1,260p' src/session.js && printf '
--- package ---
' && sed -n '1,200p' package.json && printf '
--- readme ---
' && sed -n '1,240p' README.md

/runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {Session} from './src/session.js'; const tick=()=>Promise.resolve(); let calls=0; const s=new Session({queryFn(){calls++; return Promise.resolve('stop')},timers:{schedule(){}}},{online:false}); const h=s.subscribe('central'); assert.deepEqual(s.snapshot('central'),{status:'pending',fetchStatus:'paused',data:null}); s.unsubscribe(h); assert.deepEqual(s.snapshot('central'),{status:'pending',fetchStatus:'idle',data:null}); s.online(true); await tick(); await tick(); assert.equal(calls,0); const h2=s.subscribe('central'); assert.equal(calls,1); await tick(); assert.deepEqual(s.snapshot('central'),{status:'success',fetchStatus:'idle',data:'stop'}); s.unsubscribe(h2); let queuedCalls=0; const queued=new Session({queryFn(){queuedCalls++;return Promise.resolve('x')},timers:{schedule(){}}},{online:false}); const qh=queued.subscribe('q'); queued.online(true); queued.unsubscribe(qh); await tick(); assert.equal(queuedCalls,0); let resolve; const pending=new Promise(r=>resolve=r); let seen; const ongoing=new Session({queryFn(ctx){seen=ctx;return pending},timers:{schedule(){}}}); const oh=ongoing.subscribe('o'); ongoing.unsubscribe(oh); resolve('cached'); await tick(); await tick(); assert.equal(seen.signal.aborted,false); assert.deepEqual(ongoing.snapshot('o'),{status:'success',fetchStatus:'idle',data:'cached'}); let consumedSignal; const abortable=new Session({queryFn(ctx){consumedSignal=ctx.signal;return new Promise(()=>{})},timers:{schedule(){}}}); const ah=abortable.subscribe('a'); abortable.unsubscribe(ah); assert.equal(consumedSignal.aborted,true); assert.deepEqual(abortable.snapshot('a'),{status:'pending',fetchStatus:'idle',data:null}); console.log('session lifecycle checks passed')"
git diff --check && git diff -- src/session.js && git status --short

/runtime/node --check src/session.js && /runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {Session} from './src/session.js'; let calls=0; const s=new Session({queryFn(){calls++;return Promise.resolve(calls)},timers:{schedule(){}}},{online:false}); const first=s.subscribe('station'); s.unsubscribe(first); s.online(true); await Promise.resolve(); assert.equal(calls,0); const second=s.subscribe('station'); assert.equal(calls,1); await Promise.resolve(); s.unsubscribe(second); s.online(false); const paused=s.subscribe('station'); s.unsubscribe(paused); s.online(true); await Promise.resolve(); assert.equal(calls,1); console.log('paused-attempt generation check passed')" && nl -ba src/session.js | sed -n '1,105p'
